Advayavajra's works
4. Sthūlāpatti
edited by MM Hara Prasad Shastri {\S}
in Advayavajrasaṃgraha GOS 1927 Baroda
edited by Mikkyou-seiten-kenkyūkai {\M} 1.
in Taisho Daigaku Sougou Bukkyou Kenkyūjo Nenpou 10
Annual of The Institute for Comprehensive Studies of Buddhism
Taisho University 10, 1988, pp.(44/191)
^\S p.13.
% \msT (Tōkyō colour ms.) 12\verso4
% \msN (NGMPP B 22/24) [8\verso2']
vidyāyāḥ sevane prītyā samayānām ayogataḥ |
% vidyāpāśevane ... śamayānām \msT, vidyāyā ... śamayānām \msN
% surely 'prītyā !
gaṇacakre vivādaṃ ca guhyadharmaprakāśanāt || 1 ||
% IEB 323 ``Seeking to take a consort who is without sacramental preparation.'' (\& ibid. 324: ``Likewise, the first gross transgression may simply depict the unseemly circumstance of yogins searching for sexual conquests of any variety --- \textit{yakṣīs} [!], \textit{rākṣasīs}, animals, or whatever.'') ``Relying on unauthorized sacraments.''
``Showing the secret Dharma.''
śrāddhasattveṣu saddharmadeśanā anyathā bhramāt |
% śrārddha˚ \msT
saptāhaṃ vasan madhye śrāvakānāṃ mahatkṛte || 2 ||
% casan ? \msT, vasat \msN
% mahatkṛte\M] mahakṛte \S, ahaṅkṛte \msT, ahakṛte \msN
% IEB 323: ``Teaching another Dharma to those of faith, causing confusion.'' ``Staying with Śrāvakas for seven days.'' –> ``Claiming the status of a \textit{mantrin} without sufficient realization.''
yogābhyaniścite yogy abhājane guhyadeśanāt |
sthūlāpattir bhavet tena yoginaḥ saṃvarakṣatiḥ || 3 ||
% yogābhyaniścite \M] yogāt pati[ta]ś cet \S, perhaps yogātyaniścite \msT\msN
% 'yogyabhājane \msT, yogi 'bhājane \msN
% sthūlāpatyo \msT\msN
% kṣatiḥ \M] kṛtiḥ \S
pūjayitvā mahācāryaṃ yathāśaktyupacārataḥ |
% yathāśa pacārataḥ | [\msT13\recto] \msT (!)
apraticchannacittena deśayet tatkṛtau vratī || 4 ||
% tat \M] tu \S, deśayet takṛtau \msN
sthūlāpattayaḥ samāptāḥ || ||
% samāptaḥ \msN [\msN 8\verso4']
